Careers

Vacancies at MIT World Peace University are advertised here — every open post, whichever school, department, institute or facility is recruiting.

Open posts

2 posts are open

A unit that keeps its own recruitment page keeps it: this page lists the post and sends you there. Nothing on this page collects an application; each post names its own route to apply.

Academic post · Central Research Facility

Assistant Professor — Analytical and Physical Chemistry

A chemist whose research is instrument-intensive on ICP-MS and optical spectroscopy — trace and elemental analysis, electrochemistry, or materials chemistry — on the same terms: the facility as the platform, doctoral students, and a programme to build.

  • Unit Central Research Facility
  • Closes no closing date is published for this post
  • How to apply The advertisement says to apply through the university's careers portal and gives no address for it. This page is that portal, and no application route — no form, no address, no closing date — is published anywhere on the site for these two posts.
  • Advertised on /facilities/positions

Academic post · Central Research Facility

Assistant Professor — Materials Science, thin films and nanomaterials

An experimentalist in thin-film and nanomaterials research — energy materials and batteries, functional coatings, or nanoscale devices — whose work centres on deposition and FE-SEM, XRD, Raman and nanoindentation. The post carries the facility as its platform, doctoral students, and the job of building a research programme around it.

  • Unit Central Research Facility
  • Closes no closing date is published for this post
  • How to apply The advertisement says to apply through the university's careers portal and gives no address for it. This page is that portal, and no application route — no form, no address, no closing date — is published anywhere on the site for these two posts.
  • Advertised on /facilities/positions

No posts are open. When a school, department or facility advertises one it appears here, with the post, the unit, the closing date and where to apply.

Which units are advertising

Careers is not one page. Every academic unit and every facility can advertise its own posts, and this is the index of the ones doing so today.

45 schools, departments and institutes, and 1 central facility, can advertise here. One is advertising today.

  • Central Research Facility 2 open posts

Closing dates

No post on this page publishes a date it closes on. When one does, the schedule appears here and a date that has gone is marked as passed rather than left reading as an instruction.

How a school or department advertises a post

One record per post, in curated-public-surface/career/vacancies.json, and the post appears here and in its unit's row on the index above. There is no second place to remember and no page to rewrite.

A unit that has its own recruitment page — the Central Research Facility has one — keeps it, and this page links to it. The vertical aggregates a unit's posts; it does not take the unit's page away from it.

  • The post, as it should be read: what it is called and what it is.
  • The unit: one of the university's schools, departments and institutes, or a facility declared in the same file.
  • The kind: an academic post, a postdoctoral position, a doctoral studentship, or professional and technical staff.
  • The closing date, where there is one, as a real date the build can compare against today.
  • Where the full advertisement is published, which is where the post's title links.
  • Where to apply — and, where the university has not published one, the absence is rendered rather than left blank.

What this page cannot yet tell you

Computed on every build from the records themselves and never stored, so filling a value in the data file closes its gap with nothing else to remember. It is the same list the builder's --gaps option prints, because that is how the work is actually done: somebody collects every missing closing date at once, not one post at a time.

  • Application route: No way to apply is published — Assistant Professor — Analytical and Physical Chemistry; Assistant Professor — Materials Science, thin films and nanomaterials
  • Closing date: The post publishes no date it closes on — Assistant Professor — Analytical and Physical Chemistry; Assistant Professor — Materials Science, thin films and nanomaterials
  • Advertisement: No document is published for the post — Assistant Professor — Analytical and Physical Chemistry; Assistant Professor — Materials Science, thin films and nanomaterials
